utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure thing — what’s the easiest way for me to pay the club dues?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Cash is easiest for me, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Cash works for me — I can bring it by later this week.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Hana, are the club dues still due this week? I can bring mine by the center later today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not totally sure—let me check the exact due date before you bring it. If you want, I can confirm and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Hana — just let me know the exact date and I’ll bring it by then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we have on hand for the dues and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Cleo — I probably missed part of that. Just let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take a quick look at the supplies and get back to you with what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that — how much are the club dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not totally sure yet — I need to check the notice, because I don’t want to guess wrong about the dues.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries — just let me know when you’ve checked the notice, and I’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Nell, how much are the club dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet—I only heard there might be a change. I can check with someone and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. Please let me know as soon as you find out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the club dues. I heard they’re due pretty soon, so I’d check with the treasurer before it gets forgotten.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, good call — I’ll ask the treasurer and make sure it gets sorted before it slips my mind.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s a smart move — once you’ve got the amount, you’ll be all set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, I’m rounding up club dues this week—if you’re planning to renew, I can get you sorted right away. If not, no worries, just let me know what works for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’m planning to renew. Let me know the amount and where I should drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — it’s $20 for the year, and you can drop it off at my place anytime this week or I can swing by yours.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with that. How much are the dues, and when do they need to be paid?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet — can you confirm the exact dues and the payment deadline?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can check and get you the exact dues and deadline as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo, I’m just checking in about the club membership dues—when you get a chance, could you let me know if you’re able to take care of them this week?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, I can take care of them this week. Thanks for the reminder!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check on the club membership dues and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Please let me know once you’ve checked it so I can keep my plans straight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing—I’ll check the club membership dues and get back to you once I know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the club dues. I’m sorry, I forgot the amount again; can you remind me what I owe?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s $20 this month. No rush—just whenever you can get it to me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, thanks Uli — I owe you $20 then. I’ll bring it by soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I can ask around and help keep everyone on the same page about the dues.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules—that’d be a big help. I’ll keep an ear out too while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’ll check in with folks and let you know what I hear about the dues.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, right — I’ll ask around and see if anyone’s ready to chip in on the dues. If you want, I can also spread the word about the membership meeting.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please spread the word — I’ll probably swing by a bit late anyway.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let folks know about the meeting and the dues, and I’ll tell them you may be running late.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think the dues are still the same this month, but I’d like to double-check before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds right—let’s double-check the posted amount before we say anything for certain.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, let’s take a quick look at the notice board and make sure we’ve got the right amount.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check our school schedule and see when I’m free to sort out the club dues with you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — that’d be a big help. Let me know what works for you, and we’ll sort the dues out together.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll look at the calendar tonight and text you a couple of times that work for me. Then we can sort the dues together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I can check what the dues are and help sort it out with the club.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — that’d be great. Let me know what the dues are, and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I’ll ask the club and get back to you with the exact dues. Then we can figure out the best way to handle it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can help with that—want me to check the dues amount or help you get it sorted?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you check the dues amount first? I want to make sure I have the right total before I sort anything out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll check the dues amount first and let you know the total.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the dues notice yet—do you know where the membership payment should be dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—please drop it in the dues envelope at the clubhouse front desk, and I’ll make sure it gets logged right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — I’ll drop it at the clubhouse front desk in the dues envelope.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Hana, how much are the club dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the amount before I answer—I'm not sure yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No rush—just let me know when you check.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that—what’s the due amount and when do they need it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s $20 each, and I’d like to have it by Friday if that works.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me — I’ll get the $20 to you by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the dues were due soon, but I’m not fully sure of the exact amount. Did Noah say what the club wants us to do?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I’m not sure I caught the exact amount either. I should check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d help. I’ll wait for your update before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to be sure, Tess — are the club membership dues still due this week?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, they’re still due this week — I heard the deadline hasn’t changed. If you want, I can check the exact day for you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you check the exact day for me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — did the club dues go up again, or are we just collecting them this month?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just collecting them this month, I think. I’ll check and let you know if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, that’d be great — just let me know when you check.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the club dues. I might be mixing up the amount, but I can check and get back to you shortly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—just send me the amount when you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do, Leo — I’ll confirm the dues and send you the amount as soon as I’ve got it.
